rationale: A spends the entire 3 s entrance on a dark 'Atelier Norr' preloader, and the desktop top-after-entrance frame and mobile first viewport are still blank or stuck on the loader at 100%, so the hero is never seen. That undercuts its otherwise handsome dark-green and timber illustration sections. B brings in its nav, eyebrow, headline lines and an expanding growth-ring drawing in a clear stagger by ~850 ms, then tells a scroll-linked Listen/Draw/Mill/Raise story in which the timber frame builds up step by step. B's hover states (Enquire fill, underlines, deepening CTA shadow, filled scroll dial) are crisp and consistent, while A's cursor blob covers the button labels and one control is clipped.
